name: Püspökszilágy (Hungary)
description: Two equal vertical stripes of white and blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Püspökszilágy: a red and yellow-green shield with a white patriarchal cross and a green tree, bordered in white.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
